facts.value: Official high school transcripts are required if you have fewer than 24 transferable semester hours of college credit after high school, if you're applying to a program that specifically requires a high school transcript, or if you've earned an associate degree but with fewer than 24 transferable semester credits post-high school.
facts.programme_association: International Letters and Cultures (Arabic Studies) - BA

facts.value: Transcripts must reflect all four years of coursework and include your graduation date. They must be sent directly from the high school through a secure electronic service approved by ASU, by mail, or via email directly from a school official. ASU only accepts hand-delivered transcripts if they are in a sealed envelope provided by the school and does not accept faxed transcripts.
facts.programme_association: International Letters and Cultures (Arabic Studies) - BA

facts.value: ASU requires a battery average score of 170 or higher for GED tests taken after 2013. ASU also accepts HiSet, TASC, California High School Proficiency Examination, and College Credit Pathway with some limitations.
facts.programme_association: International Letters and Cultures (Arabic Studies) - BA

facts.value: ACT or SAT scores are not required for admission but may be used in place of a high school GPA if necessary. Scores must be sent to ASU directly from ACT or College Board.
facts.programme_association: International Letters and Cultures (Arabic Studies) - BA

facts.value: If you have taken AP, IB, or CLEP exams, request your scores to be sent directly to ASU.
facts.programme_association: International Letters and Cultures (Arabic Studies) - BA
